messages:
incident-bot: ALARM firing: service=model-service-east p95 latency > 1200ms (2m window). Rule: autopager/p95-heatwave. https://alerting.example/alerts/1791234561
pagerduty: PagerDuty incident PDI-8899 triggered for on-call rotation: morgan — page sent.
morgan: Acked. I'm on it. :wave:
tara: seeing uptick in EU requests too? dashboards show spike at 11:03 UTC.
morgan: yes EU and US-east. p95 -> ~1.5s, p99 -> ~3.2s. Starting reroute to dedicated pool.
devon: attempt quick fix: scale dedicated gpu pool + reduce batch_size to 8. I can run: `robin scale --pool dedicated-east --replicas +10`
morgan: running now. hitting kv-cache miss rate. warming cache with prefix keys.
lia: is there user-facing error rate? CS reports a handful of slow API errors for a customer on enterprise tier.
tara: customer impact: some slow responses causing frontend timeouts (10-20 errors/min for tenant: acme-inc). Not widespread yet.
morgan: enabling fallback model (quantized) for non-critical routes: `api config set --route /generate --model rdm-lite-q4` to maintain latency.
devon: I see autoscaler delays — initiating immediate scale override: `autoscale override --pool dedicated-east --min 12 --ttl 15m`
incident-bot: Change detected: autoscale override by devon at 11:06 UTC.
morgan: rolling canary for fallback model to 5% of traffic.
lia: can you confirm which routes are in the canary? need to tell CS precisely.
morgan: canary covers /generate-text and internal low-priority embeddings.
tara: lia, can you draft a short note for CS? "We're experiencing latency for some requests; mitigation in progress, limited customer impact."
lia: on it. posting to #cs-alerts in 2m. :thumbsup: 
devon: after scale, p95 down to ~900ms. p99 still ~2.1s. KV warm continues.
morgan: continuing monitor. If p99 stays >2s will trigger broader rollback to older tokenizer. prepping rollback doc.
tara: does anyone see error spikes in the inference sidecar logs? tail below:
```
[2026-03-17T11:07:05Z] WARN tokenization: cold-cache miss for session xYz
[2026-03-17T11:07:06Z] ERROR grpc: deadline exceeded
```
devon: those grpc timeouts match overflow on queue length. I'm throttling batch inflow at gateway: `gatewayctl set-batch-quota 0.8`
morgan: good. p95 now 380ms, p99 1.1s. Keep monitoring 10m.
pagerduty: PDI-8899 acknowledged by morgan. Escalation suppressed.
tara: once stable, we'll run RCA heatcheck and signal adjustments for batching heuristics.
lia: CS notified: "We are mitigating a latency issue impacting some customers; no data loss. We'll update in 30 minutes"
morgan: handover to devon for night shift at 11:30 UTC. I'm logging runbook steps under /incidents/PDI-8899.
devon: taking over. will continue KV warm + monitor. Ping me if p99 > 1.5s.
morgan: thanks. :heart:
incident-bot: Incident PDI-8899 status: acknowledged -> mitigated. Closing automated page chain."
